info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Appeals-v5-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Appeal Retrieval API provides a mechanism for users to access and review a list of insurance claims appeals. This endpoint enables consumers, such as insurance adjusters and claims processors, to efficiently retrieve detailed information regarding pending and resolved appeals. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their claims management process and ensure timely responses to customer inquiries. The resource supports various query parameters for filtering and sorting results, thereby enhancing usability for developers working with claims data.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of appeal claims.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch all appeal claims associated with the user's account. It provides the necessary information to help users understand the status and details of their claims.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about claims appeals. Ensure that the correct parameters are included in the body to effectively filter and obtain the desired claim appeal data.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the list of appeals.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsAppealsRequest.description: A JSON string representation of the request body for the GET operation related to claims and appeals.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the appeal request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the appeal operation.

state.description: Current state of the appeal process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the appeal in milliseconds.

message.description: Detailed message about the appeal operation status.

audit.description: Audit information related to the appeal operation.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsAppealsResponse.description: Response schema for the successful retrieval of claims appeal operations.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the appeal.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the appeal was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the appeal was processed automatically.

Audit.description: Audit information for the appeals operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time in milliseconds that the server took to process the request. This value helps in understanding the performance of the operation.
